title: Vanishing of all low order moments
statement: Let $\ell,n,k$ be nonnegative integers, let $\alpha_0,\ldots,\alpha_{n-1}$ lie in the finite field with $2^\ell$ elements, and let $S\subseteq\{0,ldots,n-1\}$. Suppose that $|S|=0$ in this field and that, for every nonnegative integer $q$ with $2q+1<k$, the sum $\sum_{j\in S}\alpha_j^{2q+1}$ is zero. Then for every nonnegative integer $p<k$, the sum $\sum_{j\in S}\alpha_j^p$ is zero.
hypotheses_covered: $\alpha$ assigns an element of the field with $2^\ell$ elements to each index
$S$ is a finite set of indices from $0$ to $n-1$
Every odd moment of order $2q+1<k$ vanishes
